name: v13.1.0
body:
## What's Changed
* perf(deps): improve dependency resolution performance by @Jguer in https://github.com/Jguer/yay/pull/2890
* feat(lua): add lua-language-server type stubs for the yay global by @beweme11 in https://github.com/Jguer/yay/pull/2884
* query: precompute metricScore and update deps by @Jguer in https://github.com/Jguer/yay/pull/2893
* feat(search): implement render-hooks for search by @Jguer in https://github.com/Jguer/yay/pull/2896
* fix(docs): respect dark theme for docs by @Jguer in https://github.com/Jguer/yay/pull/2897
* chore(docs): link examples to lua funcs by @Jguer in https://github.com/Jguer/yay/pull/2898
* Updates for file po/en.po in zh_TW by @transifex-integration[bot] in https://github.com/Jguer/yay/pull/2899
* Updates for file po/en.po in zh_CN by @transifex-integration[bot] in https://github.com/Jguer/yay/pull/2900
* Updates for file po/en.po in cs by @transifex-integration[bot] in https://github.com/Jguer/yay/pull/2901
* chore(ci): add repo-assist agentic workflow by @Jguer in https://github.com/Jguer/yay/pull/2904
* chore(deps): bump the go-all group with 3 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/Jguer/yay/pull/2902
* chore(ci): update repo-assist workflow by @Jguer in https://github.com/Jguer/yay/pull/2908
* Updates for file po/en.po in de by @transifex-integration[bot] in https://github.com/Jguer/yay/pull/2909
* Prefer repository replacements over matching AUR upgrades by @floze-the-genius in https://github.com/Jguer/yay/pull/2910
* fix(repo-assist): set GH_TOKEN on pre-activation check step by @Jguer in https://github.com/Jguer/yay/pull/2911
* chore(ci): upgrade gh-aw to v0.82.13 for gpt-5.6 model aliases by @Jguer in https://github.com/Jguer/yay/pull/2913
* fix(repo-assist): use gpt-5.6 alias instead of gpt-5.6-luna by @Jguer in https://github.com/Jguer/yay/pull/2915
* [repo-assist] refactor(workdir): remove unnecessary global NoConfirm mutation in removeMake by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/Jguer/yay/pull/2906
* [repo-assist] fix(diff): add --no-pager and package header to git diff (#1243) by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/Jguer/yay/pull/2905
* ci: pin Go 1.26 in test workflows via setup-go by @Jguer with @Copilot in https://github.com/Jguer/yay/pull/2920
* [repo-assist] perf(query): normalize package fields once per search by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/Jguer/yay/pull/2922
* fix(ci): unblock Go toolchain and strict-mode compliance in repo-assist by @Jguer in https://github.com/Jguer/yay/pull/2923
* fix(query): improve multi-term search ranking and filtering by @Jguer in https://github.com/Jguer/yay/pull/2926
* fix(diff): place --color flag before pathspec separator by @danny-kuehn in https://github.com/Jguer/yay/pull/2933
* [repo-assist] perf(query): normalize search terms once per query by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/Jguer/yay/pull/2928
* [repo-assist] test(query): cover multi-term search matching by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/Jguer/yay/pull/2938
* [repo-assist] refactor(srcinfo): deduplicate VCS updates by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/Jguer/yay/pull/2917
* [repo-assist] Ignore unknown Lua search-filter results by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/Jguer/yay/pull/2930
* Add contextual help to Yay operations by @jdholtz in https://github.com/Jguer/yay/pull/2921
* [repo-assist] test(query): normalize matcher inputs in unit test by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/Jguer/yay/pull/2942
* ci(repo-assist): fold dl.google.com into the java ecosystem by @Jguer in https://github.com/Jguer/yay/pull/2941
* Restrict GitHub Actions token permissions in flagged workflows by @Jguer with @Copilot in https://github.com/Jguer/yay/pull/2940
* feat(translate): add translation for help message by @jdholtz in https://github.com/Jguer/yay/pull/2944
* fix(aw): reduce issue noise by @Jguer in https://github.com/Jguer/yay/pull/2950
* chore(locale): update locale files by @Jguer in https://github.com/Jguer/yay/pull/2951
* fix(dep): fall back to pkgbase fields when building packages from .SRCINFO by @Jguer in https://github.com/Jguer/yay/pull/2958
* feat(lua): populate struct slice options from name-keyed tables by @Jguer in https://github.com/Jguer/yay/pull/2959
* Updates for file po/en.po in zh_CN by @transifex-integration[bot] in https://github.com/Jguer/yay/pull/2984
* Updates for file po/en.po in zh_TW by @transifex-integration[bot] in https://github.com/Jguer/yay/pull/2983
* fix(help): print description on newlines for long flags by @jdholtz in https://github.com/Jguer/yay/pull/2978
* Updates for file po/en.po in ca by @transifex-integration[bot] in https://github.com/Jguer/yay/pull/2972
* Updates for file po/en.po in ca_ES by @transifex-integration[bot] in https://github.com/Jguer/yay/pull/2971
* Updates for file po/en.po in it_IT by @transifex-integration[bot] in https://github.com/Jguer/yay/pull/2960
* Updates for file po/en.po in sv by @transifex-integration[bot] in https://github.com/Jguer/yay/pull/2985
* fix(query): keep pacman.conf repo order for exact name matches by @pujitha24 in https://github.com/Jguer/yay/pull/2987
* Updates for file po/en.po in ru_RU by @transifex-integration[bot] in https://github.com/Jguer/yay/pull/2956
* Updates for file po/en.po in ru by @transifex-integration[bot] in https://github.com/Jguer/yay/pull/2957
* [repo-assist] fix: clean up ALPM lock on interrupt by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/Jguer/yay/pull/2962
* chore(deps): bump the go-all group across 1 directory with 4 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/Jguer/yay/pull/2982
* fix(vcs): separate ls-remote options from operands by @Jguer in https://github.com/Jguer/yay/pull/3002
* docs(lua): sync meta stubs for v13.1.0 by @Jguer in https://github.com/Jguer/yay/pull/3003

## New Contributors
* @beweme11 made their first contribution in https://github.com/Jguer/yay/pull/2884
* @floze-the-genius made their first contribution in https://github.com/Jguer/yay/pull/2910
* @github-actions[bot] made their first contribution in https://github.com/Jguer/yay/pull/2906
* @danny-kuehn made their first contribution in https://github.com/Jguer/yay/pull/2933
* @pujitha24 made their first contribution in https://github.com/Jguer/yay/pull/2987

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Jguer/yay/compare/v13.0.1...v13.1.0
